content:
@Kevin Wilson I'd be keen to see this PR in, it is useful for something I am looking at.

Would you be able to make the changes @Jireh Loreaux suggested?

And while we're here, could I ask for Mahler measure experts (@Fabrizio Barroero?) to also take a look at #37349, which makes a minor refactor so we can prove the Mignotte bound? All the work was already done, it just needs a little repackaging.
Hi Kim. Sure, I can make those changes. In my own work, I've just been doing the dance around map everywhere and it's been working fine but it is clunky. Happy to get this merged if it's helpful :-)
Also, #37349 is interesting as I basically just extracted a version of these lemmas this weekend but hadn't had a chance to package them up nicely for submission :-)
I've done the refactors as suggested by Jireh and pushed to #33463
Thanks for the further comments. Cleaned up a couple of further things with those and pushed. Should be good to go :-)

Kim Morrison said:

And while we're here, could I ask for Mahler measure experts (Fabrizio Barroero?) to also take a look at #37349, which makes a minor refactor so we can prove the Mignotte bound? All the work was already done, it just needs a little repackaging.

Sorry, my daughter was born one week ago. She’s making me take a break from Lean :joy::joy:
Congratulations! Funny story, my second child is to-be-born no later than Thursday. :-)

Also, @Kim Morrison @Jireh Loreaux this isn't quite done (too much duplication) but here is the commit I have proving that the number of reducible monics of degree n is O(H^(n-1)). This was my original use case for mapMahlerMeasure and I ended up really only needing one lemma as opposed to the whole infrastructure.

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/37663/changes
